name: alpha-encoder
description: §11.2 — bringing the alpha channel's quantizer up to the same generation as L/a/b. `alpha_ac_fit=1` routes alpha through `quantize_ac_channel`, so `scale_fit` (search the scale code by reconstruction SSE) and `ac_nearest` (pick the code nearest in reconstruction, not in the companded domain) apply to it. Both were adopted for the colour channels and were worth −0.43% and −0.05% there; alpha has never had either. The arms separate the two effects and check that neither depends on the layout. Every arm pins `alpha_ac_count` and `alpha_ac_bits` explicitly. A config that overrides only part of a layout inherits the rest from Tunables::DEFAULT, so when the default alpha allocation changed in §11.3 these arms silently stopped being 32 bytes — the same class of drift the corpus pins exist to prevent, in the knob space rather than the corpus.
